episodes.title: Early Computing
episodes.description: Trace humanity's need for calculation and the devices developed to handle increasingly demanding tasks.

episodes.title: Electronic Computing
episodes.description: Follow the transition from electromechanical machines to much larger and more capable electronic computers.

episodes.title: Boolean Logic & Logic Gates
episodes.description: Build the basic NOT, AND, and OR operations from transistors and logic circuits.

episodes.title: Representing Numbers and Letters with Binary
episodes.description: Explore how computers encode numbers, letters, and other information using binary values.

episodes.title: How Computers Calculate – the ALU
episodes.description: Investigate the arithmetic and logic unit that performs a computer's fundamental calculations.

episodes.title: Registers and RAM
episodes.description: Build bit-storage circuits from logic gates and scale them into working memory.

episodes.title: The Central Processing Unit (CPU)
episodes.description: Combine arithmetic and memory components into a processor capable of executing programs.

episodes.title: Instructions & Programs
episodes.description: Follow instructions through a processor to see how programs work at machine level.

episodes.title: Advanced CPU Designs
episodes.description: Explore hardware strategies developed to improve processor performance.

episodes.title: Early Programming
episodes.description: Trace early methods for giving machines instructions, from textile looms to computer programming.

episodes.title: The First Programming Languages
episodes.description: Discover why programmable software emerged as an alternative to wiring and switches.

episodes.title: Programming Basics – Statements & Functions
episodes.description: Use a simple game to explore statements, functions, and other programming building blocks.

episodes.title: Intro to Algorithms
episodes.description: Explore algorithms as step-by-step procedures for efficient computation.

episodes.title: Data Structures
episodes.description: Examine ways of organizing and storing data so programs can use it effectively.

episodes.title: Alan Turing
episodes.description: Connect Turing's theoretical machines, wartime codebreaking, and ideas about artificial intelligence.

episodes.title: Software Engineering
episodes.description: Explore the teamwork, practices, and tools needed to build large software systems.

episodes.title: Integrated Circuits & Moore’s Law
episodes.description: Investigate integrated circuits and the historical trend described by Moore's observation about transistor counts.

episodes.title: Operating Systems
episodes.description: Discover how operating systems emerged to automate computer use and manage execution.

episodes.title: Memory & Storage
episodes.description: Distinguish working memory from persistent storage that survives a loss of power.

episodes.title: Files & File Systems
episodes.description: Explore file encoding and the systems computers use to organize stored information.

episodes.title: Compression
episodes.description: Compare exact reconstruction through lossless compression with smaller files created by discarding less noticeable information.

episodes.title: Keyboards & Command Line Interfaces
episodes.description: Trace early human-computer interaction through keyboards and text-based commands.

episodes.title: Screens & 2D Graphics
episodes.description: Explore the screen technologies and graphics methods that made visual computer interaction possible.

episodes.title: The Cold War and Consumerism
episodes.description: Connect the Cold War, space race, consumer demand, and globalization with computing's transformation.

episodes.title: The Personal Computer Revolution
episodes.description: Trace personal computing's emergence as components became capable and affordable enough for individual users.

episodes.title: Graphical User Interfaces
episodes.description: Explore how visual interfaces made computers more approachable beyond command-line users.

episodes.title: 3D Graphics
episodes.description: Examine meshes, lighting, textures, rendering, and specialized hardware used to display three-dimensional graphics.

episodes.title: Computer Networks
episodes.description: Trace computer networking from local connections to worldwide systems, including protocols and packet routing.

episodes.title: The Internet
episodes.description: Follow how connected networks deliver information when a user requests an online resource.

episodes.title: The World Wide Web
episodes.description: Distinguish the Web from its underlying Internet infrastructure and explore the importance of linked pages.

episodes.title: Cybersecurity
episodes.description: Explore cybersecurity’s goals of confidentiality, integrity, and availability, along with authentication, access controls, and defenses against common attacks.

episodes.title: Hackers & Cyber Attacks
episodes.description: Compare malicious intrusions with security-focused hacking and explore common attack strategies.

episodes.title: Cryptography
episodes.description: Trace methods for protecting private messages through encryption and decryption.

episodes.title: Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence
episodes.description: Explore how computers learn from examples and apply patterns to decisions and predictions.

episodes.title: Computer Vision
episodes.description: Investigate the difference between recording digital pictures and interpreting their contents computationally.

episodes.title: Natural Language Processing
episodes.description: Explore the challenges computers face when interpreting human speech and generating language.

episodes.title: Robots
episodes.description: Trace robotics from its origins to practical machines and the control systems that guide them.

episodes.title: Psychology of Computing
episodes.description: Consider human psychology when designing understandable and usable computer systems.

episodes.title: Educational Technology
episodes.description: Explore ways computing and interactive technologies can support learning inside and outside classrooms.

episodes.title: The Singularity, Skynet, and the Future of Computing
episodes.description: Consider possible computing futures, including artificial intelligence, autonomous systems, wearables, and brain interfaces.
